page.layout: Top: two woodcut coin medallions side by side, with legends around their rims. Below them: one block of running text in one column, with two paragraphs. Below the text: a decorative woodcut ornament. Running head at the top centre, page number at the top right.

main_text.l: P. CORNELIVS SCIPIO, dictus Africanus maior,
ab Africa devicta, annos natus 2 4. vir Romanorum omnium
& sua ætate, & posteriori tempore ferè primus, quasi novâ inte-
gràmque provinciâ ultor patris, & patrui invadit, Carthaginê
Hispaniæ capit, in qua omne aurum & argentum, & belli appa-
ratum Afri habebant: nobilissimos obsides, Magonem etiam
Annibalis fratrem, ibi capit, quem Romã cum aliis mittit. Non
contentus Pœnos expulisse, stipendiariâ Romanis provinciam
facit: omnem citra ultráq; Iberum subiecit imperio: primúsque
Romanorum ducum victor ad Gades pervenit: plus etiam pro-
vinciam retinere quàm facere studuit. Hispanorū obsides pat-
rẽtibus reddidit: quare omnes ferè Hispaniæ ad eum trâsierunt.
Asdrubalem, Annibalis fratrẽ victum fugavit, prædámque ma-
ximam cepit. Senex tandẽ invidiæ cedens, Linternum exulat,
ubi sepultus creditur. Vide Eutr. li. 3. & Flor. li. 2. exulavit anno
à mundo condito 3777. ante Christum natum 185.
TERENTIA Æmylia, Scipionis Africani uxor, præter
uxorum morem, cùm videret senem maritũ ancillulam depe-
rire, ne eius dignitas imminueretur, reticuit, constantíque ani-
mo pertulit: quinetiam eo mortuo, ad tollendam suspicionem,
ancillam manumisit, libertóque suo in matrimonium colloca-
uit. Vide Supplemen.chro.

page.notes: Two woodcut coin medallions above the text. Left: profile of a man, legend "SCIPIO" and "AFRICANVS". Right: profile of a woman, legend "TERENTIA AEMILIA" with "SCIPIONIS AEM..." partly illegible; the legend is set around the rim and is not fully legible. Decorative woodcut ornament below the text, no printed words. Words are set with the printed spacing; "Rom anis" in the first paragraph is printed with a gap, read as Romanis. The second paragraph's TERENTIA opener is set in capitals, so it is kept as running text.
